name: @benosjs/flagship
description: The Benos 0.5 flagship project editor as executable code, with the equivalent React stack for comparison.

scripts.build: vite build --config vite.config.ts && FLAGSHIP_FRAMEWORK=react vite build --config vite.config.ts && FLAGSHIP_FRAMEWORK=react-shadcn vite build --config vite.config.ts
scripts.build:plain: FLAGSHIP_SCHEMA=plain vite build --config vite.config.ts && FLAGSHIP_SCHEMA=plain FLAGSHIP_FRAMEWORK=react vite build --config vite.config.ts && FLAGSHIP_SCHEMA=plain FLAGSHIP_FRAMEWORK=react-shadcn vite build --config vite.config.ts
scripts.compare: pnpm build && pnpm build:plain && node scripts/compare.mjs
